title: R-201 擴充:聯名戶逐持有人通報
description: 聯名帳戶需對每位持有人各通報一次,故加入持有人關聯。

files.full_content:
-- R-201: 單日 ATM 現金提領累計達 100000(含)通報(含聯名戶擴充)
SELECT
    t.account_id,
    j.holder_id,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
FROM transactions t
JOIN joint_holders j ON j.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.tx_type = 'WITHDRAW'
  AND t.channel = 'ATM'
  AND t.currency = 'TWD'
  AND t.tx_time >= :start_date AND t.tx_time < :end_date
GROUP BY t.account_id, j.holder_id
HAVING SUM(t.amount) >= 100000;

_golden.intent: 驗抑制是「定向」而非全域:bind-reversal-netted 只宣告 suppress H001,H002(通報粒度/聯名戶 fan-out)必須照常出現。若 H002 也消失,代表 suppress 濾除範圍過寬。
